operation_details.item: The campaign was originally planned to launch in June.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hi, I wanted to walk you through the latest status on the summer campaign before we update the stakeholders.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sure, I'm ready. What's changed since we last spoke?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Well, the biggest change is the timeline. The campaign was originally planned to launch in June.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. So we've moved away from June entirely? What's the new launch window?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes. The campaign is now planned to launch in July.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. Can you remind me what drove the shift? Was it a resourcing issue or something else?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Mostly it was about making sure the assets were right. The delay allowed the new creative to be finished.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. So the creative is complete now? And is there any risk of further movement on the date?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: No risk of movement. The launch date is locked in the campaign calendar.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Perfect. I'll update the project plan to reflect July as the launch month and note the creative completion. Do you have everything you need for the stakeholder update?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I think so. We'll present it as a deliberate adjustment to ensure the creative quality.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sounds good. Let me know if you need a draft summary or a visual timeline for that update.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Thanks, I'll follow up if I do.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great, I'll keep the calendar note as the source of truth. Talk soon.
